title: Frontend: User settings page — profile, password, AI config, notification preferences
description: Build the Settings page with sections for profile editing, password change, AI configuration, and notification preferences.
acceptanceCriteria: Settings page at /settings with section tabs or cards
Profile section: name + avatar URL fields with Save button
Password section: hidden for OAuth-only users
AI section: provider select + API key field (TASK-114)

steps.details: Create src/pages/SettingsPage.tsx. Card sections layout: Profile, Security, AI Settings, Notifications, Account. Each section is a separate Card with its own Save action.
Pre-fill name and avatarUrl from authStore user. Submit: PATCH /api/users/me. On success: update authStore user, show success toast.
If user has no password (OAuth-only), show 'Password login is not available for OAuth accounts'. Otherwise, show currentPassword + newPassword fields. Submit: PATCH /api/users/me/password.
Switch for emailNotificationsEnabled. On toggle: PATCH /api/users/me with { emailNotificationsEnabled }.
Navigate to /settings. Update name — verify saved. Toggle email notifications — verify state persists on reload. Try delete account (cancel) — verify not deleted.
